info.title: dotnet dotgram — the DotGram parser generator as a command
info.description: The DotGram generator outside the build: writes the parsers a build would generate, so that a project compiles them without referencing the generator.

commands.name: generate
commands.description:
write the parsers a build would generate (dotnet dotgram generate --help)
--skill      print the guide for coding agents (SKILL.md)
--version    print the tool's and the generator's versions
--help       print this

options.name: --output
options.description: where the files go (required); nothing else in it is touched

options.name: --framework
options.description:
one framework only: for a project, one of its target frameworks
(default: each of them); for a .gram, netstandard2.0, or net8.0 or
later, a framework later than net10.0 against net10.0's
references (default: net10.0)

options.name: --configuration
options.description: the project's configuration (default Release)

options.name: --line-paths
options.description: #line paths relative to <dir> (default), or as a build writes them

options.name: --allow-unresolved
options.description: generate even where the project's code has errors (reported as warnings)

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
print the stack trace of a failure inside the generator
For a .gram input only (a project's build decides these for a project):

options.name: --reference
options.description: an assembly the grammar's types come from (every *.dll of a dir)

options.name: --package
options.description: a package's assemblies, from the global packages folder

options.name: --define
options.description:
a preprocessor symbol, beside the framework's; several in one
value, separated by ; or ,

options.name: --langversion
options.description: the C# version (default: the SDK's for the framework)

options.name: --namespace
options.description: the host's namespace (default: none)

options.name: --class
options.description: the host's name (default: the file's name)

options.name: --public
options.description: a public host (default: internal)

options.name: --option
options.description:
a [Gram] property: Lexical=true, Carrier=Immediate,
LocationType=My.ISpan, Name=Fast, TargetMethodPartSize=200, ...

options.name: --sources
options.description:
C# the grammar builds, and a partial host with the members its
hooks call (no [Gram] on it)
-- ends the options: every argument after it is the input, a dash in front or not.
@file.rsp anywhere is replaced by the arguments in that file: separated by blanks or line
ends, "quoted" to keep blanks, # starting a comment line, @ nesting. A relative path in it is
read against the file's own directory.
Exit codes:
0  generated
2  grammar errors (nothing written), unless every one is GRAM3004, which exits 3; for a .gram,
a parser that does not compile
3  usage, input or output, a project not restored, MSBuild failing for a framework, a generator
that will not load, an error the project's build would report too (nothing written),
frameworks that generate different files
